notes.title: Patch 1.85, General improvements and user request solved.
notes.content:
Hi to everybody! Here is the latest patch that improves the game.

Patch to 1.85.00. Version / Valid for PC, Mac & Linux versions
1- Visual guides improved and new ones added.
2- One enemy’s lazy ass weapon didn’t sound at shooting, now fixed.
3- Stabilized de sound track at levels.
4- You also can Shoot with “K” on the keyboard (user requested).
5- Fixed text issues in the story.
6- Removed gnome of the code whom can stole your soul while playing.
7- Centralized ever version of the game at one stable number.

Thanks a lot to eveyone!
Arcanebits
